M1.reason: Measured silhouette overlap is 0.974 front/back, 0.948 left/right and 0.958 top/below, all above 0.80. In the six views the outline matches: the coat's length, the arm swing and the bent-knee walk read the same. The only shape departure is the coat hem and its tail, which is charged under M3 and M8 and does not change the overall outline.

M2.reason: Original 33.3 x 21.7 x 68, reproduction 33.2 x 21.5 x 68. Every dimension is within 1.1% of the original's.

M3.reason: Original parts checked: glasses, grey hair at the sides, bald crown, head, collar, tie, belt and buckle, coat with lapels, coat-tail flap and hem, trousers, brown shoes, two hands. All are present in the reproduction in the same places. The tie and collar are less distinct, but no part is missing or the wrong count.

M4.reason: Measured mean delta E 9.4, under 15, with front 11.7 and the largest view below at 19.7. Close up, the white coat, the blue shirt, the red tie, the brown shoes and the skin each read as the same colour as the original. The reproduction's tie is a little softer and the coat a little greyer, but neither is a different colour.

M5.reason: The glasses and belt are there. The tie's red stripes are soft and faint compared with the original's, the shirt collar is less defined, and the coat's folds are jagged where the original's are smooth. The trouser creases are smoothed away.

M6.reason: At the size the game shows it, it is recognisably the same scientist, but a player would not take it for the original. The coat's ragged, cracked hem, its greyer tone, the fragmented coat-tail in the back and side views, and the weaker tie all show it is a copy.

M7.reason: The front faces the original's front, the figure is upright, and the feet stand on the same baseline in the side views.

M8.reason: The GoldSrc check reports no errors, and 362 triangles is under the 1,480 cap (twice the original's 740). In the back and below views the coat hem looks open and ragged. In the run frames (6/22, 9/22, 13/22) a coat panel and a leg detach and float clear of the body.

C1.reason: In motion.png the body and legs hold through the run, but the coat's rear panel separates and floats clear of the body in reproduction frames 6/22, 9/22 and 13/22, and a shoe trails below the hem. The original's coat stays on the body through the same frames. This is a clear fault, not a missing part.
